items.excerpt: The Regrid MCP Server is available at: https://support.regrid.com/mcp
The MCP server utilizes the exact same API token as your traditional REST setup, and usage permissions inherit directly from your existing account tier.

items.excerpt: Preview live responses, explore endpoints, and validate your workflows in a secure testing environment. Free for 30 days.
Create an account, generate an API token, and start integrating immediately.
Each token can be provisioned to access all data or limit access to specific datasets if the account has premium add-on datasets.
Start with 2,000 Parcel records per month plus additional per record pricing.
